title: Blocks, Components, References & Reuse: the professional block subsystem
objective: Deliver the professional blocks/components/references subsystem on the frozen CAD/BIM Product Architecture v1.0 (Issue #84; the CAD-PARITY program's next AutoCAD-class subsystem after CAD-PARITY-005 merged at d859feb): reusable block/component definitions (a versioned, id-keyed block-definition table with canonical blk-NNNNNN identity, insertion base point and validated inline entity content — the CAD-PARITY-003 geometry vocabulary + CAD-PARITY-005 text + attribute definitions; edited through the DocumentEdit command model: one edit = one revision = one undo entry, with reference-checked removal against instances AND other definitions' content — no silent cascade); block instances + transforms (block-ref elements carrying blockId + insertion point + uniform scale + rotation; MOVE/ROTATE/SCALE/COPY transform the instance placement exactly through the shared entity.modify kernel; MIRROR is an explicit typed decline — mirrored content needs negative/non-uniform scales, honestly out of the bounded slice); nested blocks (inline block-ref content with COMPOSED similarity transforms — cycles rejected and the total nesting depth capped at write time so render-time expansion can never recurse unboundedly); insertion/explode workflows (BLOCK converts selected entities into definition content and removes the sources in ONE atomic revision; INSERT places an instance and prompts ONE VALUE PER attribute definition through the prompt engine's NEW rematerializing dynamic steps; EXPLODE materializes the definition content at the instance transform — attributes become text entities, nested references stay references: one level per explode, AutoCAD semantics); attributes / attribute editing (ATTDEF adds slots to a definition — every instance renders the new slot through the shared expansion without re-insertion; ATTEDIT edits per-instance values; attribute.update is the inspector write path with clear-to-default semantics); external references bounded first slice (an xref table with canonical xr-NNNNNN identity, path + status loaded/unresolved + sha-256 source-hash provenance; XATTACH attaches unresolved through the command line — the engine-free core cannot read files, an honest LOCK-013 bound — while the References palette attaches with resolved content through the host file dialog (the ifc.import payload precedent); reload re-resolves with fresh content; detach removes record + instances as ONE atomic batch; unresolved references render the canonical placeholder box with typed diagnostics; NO binding/overlay/underlay — explicit non-goals); canonical identity + provenance (document-minted monotonic blk-/xr- identities that are never reused — deletion never permits identity reuse — and the canonical-minimal history counters keep pre-006 documents byte-identical); definition → instance propagation (instance content is DERIVED from the definition at render/pick/explode time through the ONE shared similarity-transform expansion — never duplicated — so a definition edit changes every instance on both hosts); Web/Electron parity (the SAME shared core drives both hosts; the Insert ribbon surfaces the 10 commands; the Properties inspector shows Block/Reference Instance sections; the Blocks palette manages definitions + the xref manager with real file dialogs on desktop; BOTH hosts assert the SAME pinned 006 parity fixture and the SAME 32-command semantic stream); Vercel deployed verification (the exact PR head deployed and verified against all four pinned fixtures + a deployed blocks protocol + the deployed browser protocol).
acceptance_criteria: Semantic correctness: every advertised blocks operation computes deterministic results with explicit typed failure behavior (LOCK-007 — unknown names/ids, unknown attribute tags, malformed inline entities, cyclic or over-deep nesting, non-positive scales, duplicate names, locked-layer instance modifications and frozen-layer instance creations are rejected with stable codes, never silently repaired; MIRROR on instances and exploding xref instances are explicit typed declines naming the limitation).

Identity honesty: block-definition and xref identities are document-minted, monotonic and never reused (deletion never permits identity reuse); instances reference definitions by the immutable canonical id (rename-safe); the provenance source hash pins the exact external content bytes; the history's block/xref mint counters are canonical-minimal — pre-006 documents (and the pinned 002/004/005 parity fixtures) stay byte-identical.

Atomicity: BLOCK conversion (definition + source removal), xref attach (record + instance) and xref detach (record + instances) each apply as ONE versioned revision — one undo entry restores everything together; EXPLODE materialization and instance placement edits are single atomic revisions; undo/redo converge exactly (deep-equal snapshots incl. key-removal restores through the full-record setBlockDefRecord/setXrefRecord inverses).

Propagation: instance content is DERIVED from the referenced definition at render/pick/explode time through the ONE shared expansion core (similarity transforms composed exactly across nesting; attribute values materialize as text — instance value first, definition default second, nothing for empty slots); a definition edit changes every instance on BOTH hosts with no duplication; expansion through a missing definition renders the honest placeholder, never a crash.

Associativity bounds: dimensions/leaders do not attach to block content (entity-pick validators reject with typed messages); annotations reference element ids only — the block-content inline records carry no element identity, so the CAD-PARITY-005 associative cascade is unaffected (regression-pinned by the byte-identical 005 fixture).

Interaction parity: the SAME 10-command Insert vocabulary (BLOCK, INSERT, ATTDEF, ATTEDIT, XATTACH, XDETACH, XRELOAD, XLIST, XREF, BLOCKLIST) runs through the deterministic prompt engine on BOTH hosts; INSERT's per-attribute prompts appear once the block name is known (rematerializing dynamic steps — prefix-stable, same ctx + values → same steps, every host); both hosts' canvas pick of block content selects the WHOLE instance; the inspector edits placement + attribute values; the References palette attach/reload/detach with real content; the Web smoke AND the Electron real-UI smoke assert the IDENTICAL save sha AND the IDENTICAL 32-command semantic stream (LOCK-004).

Persistence: save/open round-trips the full blocks world (definitions, instances with attribute values, xref records with resolved content + provenance) byte-exactly; reopening adopts the tables with full integrity validation (duplicate names, dangling instance references, cyclic definitions and malformed inline entities reject); mint counters persist and continue past the reopened values.

Governance: the CI workflow (cad-parity-006.yml) runs the 803-test app suite (737 pre-existing + 66 new), the LOCK-018 forbidden-import scan over the extended workspace core, the web lint/typecheck/build + ALL FOUR pinned parity fixtures, and the Electron build + 13 real-UI smokes; the exact PR head is deployed to Vercel and the deployment is verified against the pinned fixtures + a deployed blocks protocol + the deployed browser protocol with zero page errors.
non_goals: No dynamic blocks (no parameters, visibility states, flip/lookup actions) — CAD-2D-007's dynamic slice is future scope.
No ByBlock property resolution (instance display overrides never cascade into content; content renders with its own authored layer/display through the standard ByLayer chain).
No non-uniform or negative instance scaling (uniform positive scale only — INSERT validates; MIRROR on instances is a typed decline) and no mirrored block content.

No xref binding, overlay/underlay distinction, path repathing or nested xref resolution — the bounded first slice is attach/detach/reload/status-diagnostics only; exploding an xref instance is a typed decline.
No block editor surface (no BEDIT/BSAVE — definition editing happens through BLOCK redefinition and ATTDEF; documented bounded workflow).
No WBLOCK/block write-out, no attribute extraction (ATTEXT/DAT), no invisible/constant/verify/preset attribute modes, no multiline attributes.
No grips on instance sub-entities (the insertion point edit flows through the inspector placement fields and the shared modify ops).
risk_assumptions: The prompt engine's dynamicSteps/rematerialize extension is additive and mechanical (state carries the materialized steps; every existing command is unaffected — regression-pinned by the byte-identical 002/004/005 fixtures and the 737 pre-existing tests).

The ModelHistory counter extension is canonical-minimal; a hand-built history carrying next_block_sequence: 1 would canonicalize the field away (validateModelHistory still accepts it) — acceptable because the document writer never emits 1.

The bounded xref content rides the payload (the ifc.import precedent); external snapshot elements outside the convertible vocabulary (BIM, dims, leaders) are SKIPPED with an honest count, never guessed into content.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated suites for the blocks vocabulary (typed constructors, the attdef grammar, inline-entity normalization, exact similarity-transform math incl. nesting composition, attribute materialization, one-level explode, graph gates), the document model (minting, reference-checked removal, exact inverses, snapshot/open integrity, locking) and the App API/command surface (BLOCK conversion, INSERT dynamic prompts, ATTDEF/ATTEDIT, transforms + the mirror decline, EXPLODE nested, the xref lifecycle with provenance, inventories, save/open, determinism).

The pinned CAD-PARITY-006 parity fixture asserted by BOTH hosts (the web smoke through the real prompt engine + the Electron real-UI smoke through CDP): the identical save sha256 AND the identical 32-command semantic stream.
The pre-existing parity fixtures (002/004/005) stay byte-identical (the additive-feature default, not a repair).
A CI workflow running the full matrix (app suite + LOCK-018 scan + web build + four smokes + electron build + 13 smokes) on the PR head.

Deployed verification of the exact PR head: the Vercel deployment identity bound to the commit sha, all four fixtures byte-identical against the deployed build, a deployed blocks protocol through the deployed /api/cad, and the deployed browser protocol with zero page errors.

transitions.reason: Architect work order issued through the program channel after CAD-PARITY-005 merged (d859feb): 'CAD-PARITY-006 — Blocks, Components, References & Reuse … reusable block/component definitions, block instances + transforms, nested blocks, insertion/explode workflows, attributes / attribute editing, external references (bounded first slice), canonical identity + provenance, definition → instance propagation, Web/Electron parity, Vercel deployed verification' — explicitly preferring the shared semantic subsystem while 'preserving the frozen architecture and avoiding premature full Xref/package complexity'; Issue #84 opened carrying the scope; ready on the merged CAD-PARITY-005 foundation.
Assigned to the Z.ai implementation agent for the CAD-PARITY program.

The pinned CAD-PARITY-006 parity fixture (app/test/fixtures/cad-parity-006-blocks.json: saveSha256 a7d7ff4c191b0d71539dfaaa79729b16d6b46deb4997b9e4e9339882d42cdd49, saveSize 32741, 2 definitions, 1 xref, 32-command stream) asserted byte-exactly by the web blocks smoke (through the real prompt engine against the dev server) AND the Electron real-UI blocks smoke (28/28 checks through CDP: canvas ENTITY picks of the block sources + the instance, the dynamic INSERT prompts, the nested explode, the xref lifecycle) — Web/Electron parity (LOCK-004); the 002/004/005 fixtures stay byte-identical (a48a29a8…, f92be229…, a14ce71c…) after the canonical-minimal counter fix 0e38f14.
